posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif melted fans with the first glimpse of newborn son Vihaan and a heartfelt birthday note to husband Vicky Kaushal, even as fresh Ormax data keeps her among Bollywood's top-ranked stars despite a long screen hiatus.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh's Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' rolled out its full album on June 15 and crossed Rs 5.6 crore over the opening weekend, with critics already calling the soundtrack a modern-day classic.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt is deep into the lavish 'Love & War' shoot with a 200-dancer sequence while buzz builds around her 'Alpha' teaser and reports linking her to 'Kalki 2'.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra launched her new US homeware line this week and shared adorable Father's Day moments, matching sneakers with Nick Jonas and daughter Malti.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's 'King', co-starring daughter Suhana and eyeing a December 24 release, is fuelling two-part release buzz as he wraps a 'Love & War' song shoot.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan wrapped shooting Meghna Gulzar's 'Daayra' and is reportedly in talks for a Raj & DK project with Salman Khan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's 'Eetha' has locked an August 28 release date, even as reports of an on-set fracture surfaced and fresh Ormax data placed her in Bollywood's top five.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone, expecting her second child, is back from the Cape Town leg of 'King' shoot amid a swirling controversy over her exit from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's 'Spirit'.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar' franchise is posting massive global numbers as he heads to Japan in July, while a fresh 'Don 3' casting row keeps his fans buzzing.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan stunned in blush-pink couture at the Cannes 2026 L'Oreal gala alongside daughter Aaradhya, with Madhuri Dixit publicly defending her red-carpet look.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna's 'Cocktail 2' landed an 'A' certificate this week as she dives into intense action prep for 'Mysaa', months after marrying Vijay Deverakonda.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu dropped the trailer for 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' and delivered a keynote on women in entertainment, settling into life after her December wedding to Raj Nidimoru.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun called Ram Charan's 'Peddi' mind-blowing and has his 'AA23' with Lokesh Kanagaraj officially announced, with 'Raaka' alongside Atlee and Deepika in the pipeline.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' is racing toward Rs 400 crore globally in just 11 days, becoming South India's top grosser of 2026 and shattering an eight-year North America record.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR halted the 'Dragon' shoot for a major overhaul and paid an emotional tribute to grandfather NTR on his 103rd birth anniversary, amid an intense physical transformation.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor is at the centre of the 'Peddi' objectification debate, with director Buchi Babu Sana apologising and reshooting fresh scenes to highlight her performance ahead of a June 17 re-release.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's 'Chaand Mera Dil' with Lakshya is generating buzz despite trolling over her Bharatanatyam sequence, which choreographers defended by praising her dedication.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra welcomed their first child, a baby girl, and asked fans for privacy as they cherish the new chapter privately.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan signed with Hollywood powerhouse Anonymous Content for global representation, with a 'Jailer 2' cameo opposite Rajinikanth and 'Krrish 4' directorial plans firing up fans.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's David Dhawan comedy 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' opened to a solid debut, with the actor reflecting candidly on the trolling he weathered through 'Border 2'.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal released the soulful 'Nabz Nabz' female version this week and is gearing up for her global 'The Unstoppable' world tour spanning five continents.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman warmly complimented young prodigy Lydian Nadhaswaram on his debut symphony and joined Imtiaz Ali for a musical tribute to the BSF at the Attari border for 'Main Vaapas Aaunga'.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay was sworn in as Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister after his TVK party's stunning debut Assembly win, marking a historic pivot from superstardom to the state's top political office.
